title: Septic Service Completion Report
subtitle: Residential Septic Service: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Septic Service Completion Report covers tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area. The septic service coordinator records Residential Septic Service performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Septic Service Completion Report keeps Residential Septic Service exceptions visible until the septic service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Septic Service Completion Report at property, tank access, pump chamber, distribution area, and protected ground surface. Document tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area identity before Residential Septic Service begins. Compare tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area findings with stated Residential Septic Service criteria; route unresolved Residential Septic Service issues to qualified septic-system reviewer. For Septic Service Completion Report, confirm requirements for Residential Septic Service. Ask qualified septic-system reviewer to review Residential Septic Service conditions beyond the septic service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Completed-scope context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Residential Septic Service, identify responsible parties, property, tank access, pump chamber, distribution area, and protected ground surface, and the linked tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area source.

fields.label: System type, tank or component identifier, and access point
Occupancy, last service, symptom, and weather history

sections.title: Performed scope and verification results
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Septic Service facts for tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Septic Service completion checks
items: Access cover, riser, seal, and surface condition
Liquid level, scum, sludge, inlet, outlet, and baffle observation
Pump, float, alarm, control, and electrical indication
Backup, odor, surfacing effluent, and wet-area evidence
Vehicle, excavation, fall, biological, and confined-space boundary
Post-service level, closure, alarm, and flow observation

sections.title: Verified outcome and customer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Septic Service conditions; have septic service coordinator assign the next Residential Septic Service owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Unsafe opening, fall, biological, or confined-space exposure
Backup or surfacing effluent threatens occupancy
Damaged tank or component requires excavation
Electrical, structural, or regulatory work outside scope
Cover closure, alarm, and customer restriction evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Septic Service when access safety, containment, backup, structural integrity, disposal, or qualified escalation remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Septic Service proof and route unresolved tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area scope to septic service coordinator.
